Puked all night long and ate nothing during the day. Thanks India for allowing me to reach my target weight only by serving me some palak paneer from the hotel. Now I'm sacred to eat anything, much less from the street vendors. Andy got his sickness out of the way and was able to make it to the safari jeep ride. You know animals can hear and wouldn't stay around if they heard a jeep coming. Needless to say he saw nothing.

We drove to Jaipur and stayed in our room the rest of the evening so I could sleep. Good times.
